content: {"reasoning":"Silverbridge requires prior authorization and offers neither retroactive authorization nor peer-to-peer review; repeated submissions and necessity appeals have not resolved CO-197. This contractual-obligation denial does not establish patient liability, and deductible and coinsurance terms alone do not justify billing the denied balance. With no secondary coverage or supported remaining recovery path, the balance is uncollectible; the low historical patient-billing success does not justify transferring provider liability to the patient.","action":"write_off"}
